text: Hello, boys and girls.Nice to see you again.I'm Jean.Welcome to my class.Today, we will continue learning Unit 9.Please get your student's book, workbook and worksheet ready.In this class, you will listen to some conversations about buying and selling food, and you will learn to express the price and amounts of food.I think what you will learn today will be very useful to you in your daily life.Are you ready for the class?Let's go.First, let's check last lesson's homework.Please take out your workbook and turn to page 63.Are you ready?Here are the steps of making biscuits.Step 1.Mix the self-raising flour, the salt and butter together.Add the sugar.Pour in the milk.Use your hands to make the mixture into a dough.Make shapes about 5 cm wide.Put the shapes on a baking tray and sprinkle them with flour.Bake them in a hot oven for 15 minutes.After completing the steps, can you make biscuits by yourselves?A little bit difficult, right?What is missing?We don't know how much we will need.We can search for the amounts of ingredients on the Internet and then have a try.So much for the homework.Last class, we learnt about many different kinds of international food.Please look at the pictures and tell the food names and what kind of food they are.They are hot dogs.They are American food.It is an apple pie.It is American food.They are raisin scones.They are English food.They are prawn cakes.They are Thai food.How many prawn cakes are there on the plate?We can also say a plate of prawn cakes.Read after me.A plate of.They are moon cakes.They are Chinese food.How many moon cakes are there in the picture?A plate of moon cakes.It is pineapple fried rice.It is Thai food.Can we call it a plate of pineapple fried rice?We can call it a bowl of pineapple fried rice.A bowl of.What's their price?Are they expensive?Let's look at these pictures.How much does one raisin scone cost?It costs 3 yuan and 5 jiao.How much do two plates of fish and chips cost?They cost 18 yuan and 6 jiao.Here are more pictures.Please choose some food and make up a dialogue.Have a try.Thank you for watching.Let's listen to my students' dialogues.How much does one hamburger cost?How much do two bowls of pineapple fried rice cost?They cost 11 yuan.How much do two zongzi and one plate of fish and chips cost?Well done.Look, they are Mr.Hu and Kitty.What's on the table?They are raisin scones and fish and chips.What kind of food are they?What are Kitty and Mr.Hu doing?They are talking with each other.I found the price on the cards.Maybe Kitty is selling the food and Mr.Hu is coming to help.Where are they now?I guess they are at the International Food Festival.They are in the playground.Good guessing, everyone.Let's listen and check our prediction.Now let's listen to the recording and tell what Kitty and Mr.Hu are doing.Are they really at the International Food Festival?Is Mr.Hu coming to help?Hello, Kitty.I'd like to buy some food.What food are you selling?I'm selling raisin scones and fish and chips.How much do they cost?A raisin scone costs 3 yuan and 5 jiao and a plate of fish and chips costs 9 yuan and 3 jiao.May I have two raisin scones and a plate of fish and chips, please?Yes, of course.That'll be 16 yuan and 3 jiao.What are they doing?Kitty is selling the English food.She is a salesman.Guo is a customer.They are at the International Food Festival.In the dialogue, will Ms.Guo buy any food?Yes, she will.What will she buy and how much will she pay?Please listen to the dialogue again and complete the table.Let's check the answers.Kitty will sell English food.Guo will buy two scones and one plate of fish and chips.The total price is 16 yuan and 3 jiao.Guo and Kitty made a nice deal.Guys, do you want to buy some international food?Let's do something interesting.Suppose you are at the International Food Festival.What kind of food would you like to buy?You can choose some food you like from the pictures and complete the dialogue.Please open your student's book and turn to page 71.Ready, go.Zither HarpZither HarpZither HarpZither HarpZither HarpZither HarpVery good.Please read the dialogue again and answer the questions.
